### [Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653>)

Kimi K3 combines hybrid recurrent and latent attention, attention across residual layers, and a sparse expert architecture in a native multimodal model with 2.8 trillion total parameters and 104 billion activated parameters. Its public report connects architecture, data, optimization, and long-context post-training, providing a current reference for how several efficiency improvements support scaling a large open-weight model.

**Published:** 2026-07-27 · **First seen:** 2026-09-30T04:09:33Z · **Novelty:** baseline · **Tags:** MoE, Hybrid Attention, Scaling Laws, Multimodal

**Positioning:** frontier-research

[Paper](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653>) · [Project](<https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3>)

**Evidence:** technical-report; full-text. The August 7 revision includes architecture equations, scaling-law experiments, training schedules, and evaluation settings; Section 3.2 reports approximately 2.5x overall scaling efficiency relative to Kimi K2 on held-out validation data.

**Limitations:** The efficiency result combines multiple changes and is not an isolated architectural gain; the authors state that overall performance trails their strongest proprietary comparators, and released weights do not make the full training process reproducible.
